page_title: ALA 0-1 PAL | Alaves v Las Palmas 09/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+9' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.
90+8' Cristian Herrera (Las Palmas) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
90+7' Rafa Marin (Alaves) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Jose Luis Munuera Montero lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
90+7' What was Marvin (Las Palmas) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
90+5' Alaves quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+4' The ball is cleared after Javi Lopez (Alaves) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Good work from Alaves as they win a corner.
90+2' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
90+1' Alex Sola (Alaves) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the left post. Unlucky!
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Luis Garcia Plaza is stunned as referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
89' Alaves take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
88' Kike Garcia (Alaves) goes for goal and shoots towards the left side of the goal, but his effort is well blocked. It will be a corner kick for Alaves.
87' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta decides to make a substitution. Alberto Moleiro will be replaced by Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas).
86' That will be all from Abdelkebir Abqar who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves).
86' Substitution. Luis Rioja is replaced by Unai Ropero (Alaves).

85' Kike Garcia (Alaves) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the middle of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
84' A header by Kike Garcia (Alaves) from very close range goes towards the left-hand post, but doesn't get past Alvaro Valles, who makes a brilliant save.
84' Alaves have been awarded a corner kick.
84' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Alaves comes to nothing. The linesman makes the right call and Alaves will have a corner.
83' Luis Rioja (Alaves) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
82' Surely that's handball by one of the Las Palmas players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
82' The resulting corner, taken by Luis Rioja (Alaves), comes to nothing.

80' The corner is slung over and Abdelkebir Abqar (Alaves) out jumps the defence inside the six-yard box, but the header skims off the top of his head and goes miles wide of the right post for a goal kick.
80' The linesman points to the corner flag, Alaves are going to take it.
77' Here is a change. Antonio Blanco is going off and Luis Garcia Plaza gives the last tactical orders to Kike Garcia (Alaves).
77' Substitution. Munir El Haddadi makes way for Cristian Herrera (Las Palmas).
75' Substitution. Munir El Haddadi makes way for Cristian Herrera (Las Palmas).
75' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Alaves players look gutted.
74' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero is going to take a look using VAR.
73' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Samu Omorodion (Alaves) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
71' Alaves couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Alvaro Valles (Las Palmas) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
68' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero saw the whole situation.
64' That's a well-taken pass by Javier Munoz (Las Palmas). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
63' The substitution has been made. Alex Sola (Alaves) has replaced Abderrahmane Rebbach.
63' Substitution. Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) has come on for Ianis Hagi.
62' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to make a change. Marvin (Las Palmas) replaces Marc Cardona.
62' Substitution. Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas) in, Enzo Loiodice out.
59' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) makes a strong challenge and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul.
56' A thunderous effort from long range by Antonio Blanco (Alaves) goes well wide of the left post.
55' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Alaves due to an offside in the build-up play.
54' Wait! Referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero has indicated he is going to review the Alaves goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
53' Spectacular goal! Samu Omorodion (Alaves) brilliantly darts into the box to latch on to a cross and buries the ball into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper stunned!
48' Abdelkebir Abqar (Alaves) sees a yellow card from Jose Luis Munuera Montero after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground. Abdelkebir Abqar (Alaves) will miss the next game.
47' Jon Guridi (Alaves) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Las Palmas take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
44' Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
42' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

41' Great touch by Samu Omorodion (Alaves) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save! Corner kick. Alaves will have an opportunity.
40' Jose Luis Munuera Montero couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) and blew his whistle.
36' Dangerous play by Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves). Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot.
33' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) was quite harsh and Jose Luis Munuera Montero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
31' 0 - 1 Goal! Alberto Moleiro plays a short, square pass into the path of Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas), who bends a shot straight into the right side of the goal to make it 0:1. Fabulous goal!
28' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
22' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul after Jon Guridi (Alaves) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
20' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Alvaro Valles is alert and denies him.
19' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
19' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
13' Flag up against Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
13' Corner kick. Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) is ready to send the ball into the box.
12' Las Palmas can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
12' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee blows his whistle, Las Palmas are awarded a corner kick.
11' Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
10' A clumsy foul by Ianis Hagi (Alaves) and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle.
9' Jose Luis Munuera Montero shows a yellow card to Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) for his blatant foul.
6' What a big chance! Samu Omorodion (Alaves) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
4' Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just wide of the left post from inside the box.
2' A defender mistimes his tackle on the edge on the box and let's in Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves). It's a decent effort but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
2' A quickly taken corner by Alaves.
1' Javi Lopez (Alaves) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The ball is out of play and Alaves manage to earn a corner.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Alaves will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Jose Luis Munuera Montero.
